starting-off-talking-to-ur-tag-or-ambass.speaker: Ambassador Alvijar
starting-off-talking-to-ur-tag-or-ambass.text: Headman Ur-tag, I cannot stress enough how important it is that this train link be completed on time. The mining companies have taken out considerable loans...

starting-off-talking-to-ur-tag-or-ambass.speaker: Ur-tag
starting-off-talking-to-ur-tag-or-ambass.text: I understand your concerns, Ambassador, but you must realise that the discoveries must change the whole schedule. To remove them too hurriedly would be a crime against knowledge.

steps.speaker: Ur-tag
steps.text: It's the new underground train link being built between our city and the dwarven city of Keldagrim.
If the player doesn't have the requirements to start the quest:

steps.speaker: Ambassador Alvijar
steps.text: Shh! What if they're a human spy come to steal our engineering secrets?
You do not meet all of the requirements to start the Another Slice of H.A.M. quest.

steps.speaker: Ambassador Alvijar
steps.text: It will be the pinnacle of dwarven engineering! A great leap forward from the old steam-powered minecarts! A monument to the power and ingenuity of the Consortium!

steps.speaker: Ambassador Alvijar
steps.text: And it would be finished by now, except that they found some old goblin bones they want to dig up.

steps.speaker: Ur-tag
steps.text: We've unearthed some very important artefacts that were buried during the Dorgeshuun Civil War. They could shed important light on our history.

steps.speaker: Ur-tag
steps.text: [player name], do you have any experience with archaeology?

steps.player: I passed my archaeology exam at the Digsite!

steps.speaker: Ur-tag
steps.text: Excellent! We have not had a major archaeological project for generations, so if you could give us some help we would appreciate it.

steps.prompt: Start the Another Slice of H.A.M. quest?

steps.speaker: Ur-tag
steps.text: Splendid! The path to the train tunnel is in the south- west of the city.

steps.speaker: Ambassador Alvijar
steps.text: Perhaps now we can get this finished quickly and get on with laying the tracks.

steps.speaker: Ur-tag
steps.text: Oh well. We will continue at our own pace.

options.text: What can I do in the city?

steps.player: What can I do in the city?

steps.speaker: Ur-tag
steps.text: Why don't you visit the market? I hear there is quite a craze for surface foods at the moment, so you might be able to sell something there.

steps.speaker: Ur-tag
steps.text: You might also want to visit the caves to the south of the city. There are many monsters to fight there, and Zanik apparently found ways to cross over their heads!

options.text: Why did you decide to open the city?

steps.player: Why did you decide to open the city?

steps.speaker: Ur-tag
steps.text: For trade, and for fostering goodwill between races! I am sure that it will benefit both our races.

starting-off-talking-to-ambassador-alvij.speaker: Ambassador Alvijar
starting-off-talking-to-ambassador-alvij.text: Headman Ur-tag, I cannot stress enough how important it is that this train link be completed on time. The mining companies have taken out considerable loans...

starting-off-talking-to-ambassador-alvij.speaker: Ur-tag

starting-off-talking-to-ambassador-alvij.speaker: Ur-tag
starting-off-talking-to-ambassador-alvij.text: It's the new underground train link being built between our city and the dwarven city of Keldagrim.

starting-off-talking-to-ambassador-alvij.speaker: Ambassador Alvijar
starting-off-talking-to-ambassador-alvij.text: It will be the pinnacle of dwarven engineering! A great leap forward from the old steam-powered minecarts! A monument to the power and ingenuity of the Consortium!

starting-off-talking-to-ambassador-alvij.speaker: Ambassador Alvijar
starting-off-talking-to-ambassador-alvij.text: And it would be finished by now, except that they found some old goblin bones they want to dig up.

starting-off-talking-to-ambassador-alvij.speaker: Ur-tag
starting-off-talking-to-ambassador-alvij.text: We've unearthed some very important artefacts that were buried during the Dorgeshuun Civil War. They could shed important light on our history.

starting-off-talking-to-ambassador-alvij.speaker: Ur-tag
starting-off-talking-to-ambassador-alvij.text: [player name], do you have any experience with archaeology?

starting-off-talking-to-ambassador-alvij.player: I passed my archaeology exam at the Digsite!

starting-off-talking-to-ambassador-alvij.speaker: Ur-tag
starting-off-talking-to-ambassador-alvij.text: Excellent! We have not had a major archaeological project for generations, so if you could give us some help we would appreciate it.

starting-off-talking-to-ambassador-alvij.prompt: Start the Another Slice of H.A.M. quest?

starting-off-talking-to-ambassador-alvij.speaker: Ur-tag
starting-off-talking-to-ambassador-alvij.text: How is the archaeological dig going?

starting-off-talking-to-ambassador-alvij.speaker: Ambassador Alvijar
starting-off-talking-to-ambassador-alvij.text: I wish you could work more quickly. The new train link is very important to the dwarven economy.

options.text: What can I do in the city?
Why did you decide to open the city?

starting-off-talking-to-ambassador-alvij.speaker: Ambassador Alvijar
starting-off-talking-to-ambassador-alvij.text: I hope you're hurrying up with that archaeological dig. Every moment we wait wastes more of the Consortium's money!

the-archaeological-dig-talking-to-zanik.player: Hi Zanik. What are you doing here?

the-archaeological-dig-talking-to-zanik.speaker: Zanik
the-archaeological-dig-talking-to-zanik.text: I'm having a look at the things that are being dug up here!

the-archaeological-dig-talking-to-zanik.speaker: Zanik
the-archaeological-dig-talking-to-zanik.text: It's really amazing to think that these things were used by my ancestors hundreds of years ago. Tegdak thinks that some of them may even have been brought down here from the surface by the early Dorgeshuun!

steps.speaker: Builder
steps.text: I hope those goblins hurry up with their digging. It's so frustrating having to stop work when the train link is nearly finished!

steps.speaker: Builder
steps.text: Bah! These goblins don't appreciate how important this train link is! It'll be the greatest dwarven achievement of this generation, and it's being held up just so they can pick at old broken things in the ground.

steps.speaker: Builder
steps.text: I hope the Consortium will understand it's not our fault the work will be finished late. This is the most important job of my career!

steps.speaker: Builder
steps.text: I'm looking forward to riding on this train once it's finished. It'll be so much faster than the old steam-powered minecarts. It'll be the fastest machine in Gielinor!

steps.speaker: Builder
steps.text: Will you tell those goblins to get on with their digging? We've got a job to finish here.

the-archaeological-dig-talking-to-tegdak.speaker: Tegdak
the-archaeological-dig-talking-to-tegdak.text: Oh, hello surface-dweller. I'm afraid we're a bit busy cleaning specimens at the moment so I can't help you.

the-archaeological-dig-talking-to-tegdak.player: Ur-tag asked me to help out with the dig. I have an archaeology qualification!

the-archaeological-dig-talking-to-tegdak.speaker: Tegdak
the-archaeological-dig-talking-to-tegdak.text: Oh! In that case we could use your help.

the-archaeological-dig-talking-to-tegdak.speaker: Tegdak
the-archaeological-dig-talking-to-tegdak.text: There are some ancient goblin artefacts buried in the ground around here. We want to extract them, but we don't have much experience and could end up breaking them.

the-archaeological-dig-talking-to-tegdak.speaker: Tegdak
the-archaeological-dig-talking-to-tegdak.text: Could you extract them, clean them, and then give them to me please?

the-archaeological-dig-talking-to-tegdak.speaker: Tegdak
the-archaeological-dig-talking-to-tegdak.text: Here, take this trowel and specimen brush.

the-archaeological-dig-talking-to-tegdak.speaker: Tegdak
the-archaeological-dig-talking-to-tegdak.text: How are you getting on with extracting the artefacts?
If the player doesn't have a trowel:

steps.text: If there is no inventory space:

steps.speaker: Tegdak
steps.text: Well, you'll have to free up some inventory space before I can give you a new one.
If there is inventory space:

steps.speaker: Tegdak
steps.text: Never mind. Have another one.

the-archaeological-dig-talking-to-tegdak.text: If the player doesn't have a specimen brush:

steps.player: And I lost my specimen brush.

steps.text: If there is no inventory space:

steps.speaker: Tegdak
steps.text: Well you'll have to free up some inventory space before I can give you a new one.
If there is inventory space:

steps.speaker: Tegdak
steps.text: Never mind. Have another one.

the-archaeological-dig-talking-to-tegdak.speaker: Tegdak
the-archaeological-dig-talking-to-tegdak.text: Thanks for extracting that artefact, but you'll need to clean it as well.
If the player does not have a specimen brush:

steps.text: If the player does not have inventory space:

steps.speaker: Tegdak
steps.text: I've got a sample brush here but you'll have to make space in your inventory for me to give it to you.
If the player has inventory space:

steps.speaker: Tegdak
steps.text: Here, use this brush to clean the artefact.

the-archaeological-dig-attempting-to-cle.text: You will need a specimen brush in order to clean the artefact.

the-archaeological-dig-cleaning-an-artef.text: You clean the find with your brush.

the-archaeological-dig-dropping-an-artef.text: You drop the artefact and it rolls back to its original place in the ground.

the-archaeological-dig-using-an-item-tha.speaker: Tegdak
the-archaeological-dig-using-an-item-tha.text: What? No, extract the artefacts please.

the-archaeological-dig-talking-to-tegdak.speaker: Tegdak
the-archaeological-dig-talking-to-tegdak.text: Thank you, [player name]!

the-archaeological-dig-talking-to-tegdak.speaker: Zanik
the-archaeological-dig-talking-to-tegdak.text: What is it?
If the artefact is an armour shard:

steps.speaker: Tegdak
steps.text: It looks like a fragment of armour.

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: Look at the design! That's a lot like the design of the goblin armour I saw on the surface.

steps.speaker: Tegdak
steps.text: That confirms that our ancestors retained a lot of customs from the surface even after they came down here. Our guards didn't start wearing lighter chainmail until after the Civil War.
If that was the sixth artefact handed in:

steps.speaker: Tegdak
steps.text: That's all the artefacts we needed to extract. Thanks again, [player name]!

steps.speaker: Tegdak
steps.text: Now, the most interesting one is this ancient mace. It's the only intact weapon, and I'm pretty sure it dates back to the time when the Dorgeshuun were on the surface.

steps.speaker: Tegdak
steps.text: It's covered in symbols, but I can't decipher them. Zanik, could you take it to the scribe? He might know what they mean. I'll finish up the dig here.

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: Sure thing! Come on, [player name], let's go talk to the scribe
Zanik starts following the player.
If the player has another cleaned artefact:

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: What is it?
If the player does not have another cleaned artefact:

the-archaeological-dig-talking-to-tegdak.text: If the artefact is a shield fragment:

steps.speaker: Tegdak
steps.text: It looks like a piece of a shield.

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: Look at that stress fracture. It looks like this shield broke pretty easily.

steps.speaker: Tegdak
steps.text: I would guess that this shield was made during the Dorgeshuun Civil War and not handed down from the time on the surface.

steps.speaker: Tegdak
steps.text: It seems that even by the time of the Civil War, our ancestors were beginning to lose their skills at making weapons.
If that was the sixth artefact handed in:
If the player has another cleaned artefact:
If the player does not have another cleaned artefact:

the-archaeological-dig-talking-to-tegdak.text: If the artefact is a helmet fragment:

steps.speaker: Tegdak
steps.text: It looks like a piece of a helmet.

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: A helmet? So those are eye-holes? They look too small.

steps.speaker: Tegdak
steps.text: This was from the early days of Dorgesh-Kaan. It must have been before our ancestors' eyes reached their current size.
If that was the sixth artefact handed in:
If the player has another cleaned artefact:
If the player does not have another cleaned artefact:

the-archaeological-dig-talking-to-tegdak.text: If the artefact is a sword fragment:

steps.speaker: Tegdak
steps.text: I'm not sure. What do you think?

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: It looks a bit like a sword, doesn't it? I saw some people using them on the surface.

steps.speaker: Tegdak
steps.text: The early Dorgeshuun must have used a much larger variety of weapons than we do now.
If that was the sixth artefact handed in:
If the player has another cleaned artefact:
If the player does not have another cleaned artefact:

the-archaeological-dig-talking-to-tegdak.text: If the artefact is an axe head:

steps.speaker: Tegdak
steps.text: I'm not sure. It's got some kind of blade... Is it a spear tip?

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: Oh, I know what it is! It's an axe head!

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: Axes are these things they use on the surface for cutting down trees. I think they can be used as weapons too.

steps.speaker: Tegdak
steps.text: Our ancestors must have brought it down from the surface, then. There would be no need for them to make axes when they were down here, as there are no trees.

steps.speaker: Tegdak
steps.text: It's amazing to think that we're handling objects that date back to the time of the war of the gods!
If that was the sixth artefact handed in:
If the player has another cleaned artefact:
If the player does not have another cleaned artefact:

the-archaeological-dig-talking-to-tegdak.text: If the artefact is a mace:

steps.speaker: Tegdak
steps.text: It's... Actually, what is it? It's a sort of stick with a lump on the end.

steps.speaker: Tegdak
steps.text: A mace?
If that was the sixth artefact handed in:
If the player has another cleaned artefact:
If the player does not have another cleaned artefact:

the-archaeological-dig-talking-to-tegdak.speaker: Tegdak
the-archaeological-dig-talking-to-tegdak.text: How are you getting on with extracting the artefacts?

the-archaeological-dig-talking-to-tegdak.player: I haven't got any more yet.

the-archaeological-dig-talking-to-tegdak.text: If the player doesn't have a trowel:
If the player doesn't have a specimen brush:

the-archaeological-dig-talking-to-tegdak.speaker: Tegdak
the-archaeological-dig-talking-to-tegdak.text: Thanks for your help. There's not much left for us to do here except pack everything up. Have you shown that mace to the scribe yet?

the-goblin-scribe-talking-to-zanik.speaker: Zanik
the-goblin-scribe-talking-to-zanik.text: I've got a strange feeling about this mace, [player name]. Maybe when we find out about it, it will shed some light onto my destiny. Come on, let's show it to the scribe.

options.text: I need to do something else for a bit

steps.player: I need to do something else for a bit.

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: All right. I'll go back and help finish the dig.
Zanik returns to the railway

the-goblin-scribe-talking-to-zanik-picki.speaker: Zanik
the-goblin-scribe-talking-to-zanik-picki.text: Shall we go and talk to the scribe about this ancient mace now?

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: Let's go then!
Zanik starts following the player.

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: Oh well. Let me know when you're ready.

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: I've got it! I'll hold onto it until we've shown it to the scribe. Shall we go?

the-goblin-scribe-talking-to-ambassador-.speaker: Ambassador Alvijar
the-goblin-scribe-talking-to-ambassador-.text: Thank you for helping with the dig! Ur-tag tells me it will be finished soon, and then we will be able to resume work!

options.text: What can I do in the city?
Why did you decide to open the city?

the-goblin-scribe-talking-to-oldak-with-.speaker: Oldak
the-goblin-scribe-talking-to-oldak-with-.text: Ah, Zanik. Would you like to see the results of my experiment with nature runes?

the-goblin-scribe-talking-to-oldak-with-.speaker: Zanik
the-goblin-scribe-talking-to-oldak-with-.text: Not right now, Oldak. I'm helping [player name]!

the-goblin-scribe-talking-to-the-goblin-.speaker: Goblin scribe
the-goblin-scribe-talking-to-the-goblin-.text: Ah, hello Zanik, hello [player name]. How is the dig going?

the-goblin-scribe-talking-to-the-goblin-.speaker: Zanik
the-goblin-scribe-talking-to-the-goblin-.text: [player name] helped us to finish the dig! Look what she dug up!
Zanik shows the mace to the scribe.

the-goblin-scribe-talking-to-the-goblin-.speaker: Goblin scribe
the-goblin-scribe-talking-to-the-goblin-.text: Hmm... that is interesting. What do you think it is?

the-goblin-scribe-talking-to-the-goblin-.speaker: Zanik
the-goblin-scribe-talking-to-the-goblin-.text: [player name] says that's a kind of weapon.

the-goblin-scribe-talking-to-the-goblin-.speaker: Goblin scribe
the-goblin-scribe-talking-to-the-goblin-.text: I can see how. I certainly wouldn't want to be hit with it!

the-goblin-scribe-talking-to-the-goblin-.speaker: Zanik
the-goblin-scribe-talking-to-the-goblin-.text: We think it's a magical weapon from the surface. Can you decipher the symbols on it?

the-goblin-scribe-talking-to-the-goblin-.speaker: Goblin scribe
the-goblin-scribe-talking-to-the-goblin-.text: No, I'm afraid not. Our written language has developed so much since then that it's totally indecipherable to me.

the-goblin-scribe-talking-to-the-goblin-.speaker: Goblin scribe
the-goblin-scribe-talking-to-the-goblin-.text: Wait a moment. [player name], didn't you say you talked to some surface goblins when you were trying to find your way through our mines?

the-goblin-scribe-talking-to-the-goblin-.player: Yes, I talked to the generals in the Goblin Village.

the-goblin-scribe-talking-to-the-goblin-.speaker: Goblin scribe
the-goblin-scribe-talking-to-the-goblin-.text: Perhaps you could talk to them again. They might know more about weapons than we do.

the-goblin-scribe-talking-to-the-goblin-.speaker: Zanik
the-goblin-scribe-talking-to-the-goblin-.text: I'd rather not travel all that way over the surface, though. I wonder if Oldak could use magic to help us get there?

the-goblin-scribe-talking-to-the-goblin-.speaker: Goblin scribe
the-goblin-scribe-talking-to-the-goblin-.text: Hello, Zanik. Have you found out about that mace yet?

the-goblin-scribe-talking-to-the-goblin-.speaker: Zanik
the-goblin-scribe-talking-to-the-goblin-.text: Not yet. Come on, [player name]! We should go and ask the goblin generals about it!

the-goblin-scribe-talking-to-zanik-2.speaker: Zanik
the-goblin-scribe-talking-to-zanik-2.text: I can't believe we're going to the Goblin Village on the surface! I'm finally going to see how my distant relatives live!

the-goblin-scribe-talking-to-zanik-2.speaker: Zanik
the-goblin-scribe-talking-to-zanik-2.text: Actually, I'm a little nervous about what I'll find there...

options.text: I need to do something else for a bit

the-goblin-scribe-talking-to-zanik-picki.speaker: Zanik
the-goblin-scribe-talking-to-zanik-picki.text: Shall we go see Oldak now? I'm sure he'll have a way of getting us to the Goblin Village quickly!

the-goblin-scribe-talking-to-tegdak.speaker: Tegdak
the-goblin-scribe-talking-to-tegdak.text: Thanks for your help. There's not much left for us to do here except pack everything up. Have you shown that mace to the scribe yet?

the-goblin-scribe-talking-to-tegdak.player: Yes! Now we're going to go to the Goblin Village to ask the surface goblins about it!

the-goblin-scribe-talking-to-tegdak.speaker: Tegdak
the-goblin-scribe-talking-to-tegdak.text: Good idea! Maybe Oldak can help you get there.

talking-to-oldak.speaker: Oldak
talking-to-oldak.text: Ah, Zanik. Would you like to see the results of my experiment with nature runes?

talking-to-oldak.speaker: Zanik
talking-to-oldak.text: Not right now, Oldak. We wanted to see if you could make Moving-Over-Distance Spheres to somewhere other than the city.

talking-to-oldak.speaker: Oldak
talking-to-oldak.text: Oh, yes. My research along those lines has been coming along very well. I think I could make a Moving-Over-Distance Sphere to anywhere you like, given a little work.

talking-to-oldak.player: We're trying to take this ancient goblin mace to the Goblin Village on the surface. Do you think you could help us to get there?

talking-to-oldak.speaker: Oldak
talking-to-oldak.text: Hmm. The Goblin Village, you say? Yes, I think I could do that. Just a moment.
Oldak carefully measures out some crushed runes and makes a glass sphere around them.

talking-to-oldak.speaker: Oldak
talking-to-oldak.text: There you go. I've made you each one to get you to the Goblin Village and one to bring you back here.

talking-to-oldak.speaker: Zanik
talking-to-oldak.text: Thanks Oldak! Okay, [player name], let's go!
The player and Zanik both break the glass spheres on the ground and begin to teleport. Start of cutscene in Goblin Village as it fades to black

talking-to-oldak.speaker: Zanik
talking-to-oldak.text: So this is the Goblin Village! It's so different from Dorgesh-Kaan, isn't it, [player name]?
The player finally teleports to Goblin Village

talking-to-oldak.speaker: Zanik
talking-to-oldak.text: Sorry about that, [player name]! Oldak's calculations aren't always exact!

talking-to-oldak-talking-with-zanik-in-g.speaker: Zanik
talking-to-oldak-talking-with-zanik-in-g.text: So this is how goblins on the surface live! Come on, [player name], lets talk to them!

options.text: I need to do something else for a bit

talking-to-oldak-leaving-goblin-village.speaker: Zanik
talking-to-oldak-leaving-goblin-village.text: I'll meet you back in Dorgesh-Kaan, [player name].

talking-to-oldak-getting-zanik-from-the-.speaker: Zanik
talking-to-oldak-getting-zanik-from-the-.text: Come on [player name], let's get back to the Goblin Village on the surface! Shall we go?

talking-to-oldak-talking-to-zanik-in-dor.speaker: Zanik
talking-to-oldak-talking-to-zanik-in-dor.text: What are we doing here, [player name]? We should get to the Goblin Village!

options.text: I need to do something else for a bit

talking-to-oldak-returning-to-oldak-agai.speaker: Oldak
talking-to-oldak-returning-to-oldak-agai.text: Ah, Zanik. How did you get on at the Goblin Village?

talking-to-oldak-returning-to-oldak-agai.speaker: Zanik
talking-to-oldak-returning-to-oldak-agai.text: We haven't finished there actually. Do you think you could teleport us there again?
The player and Zanik both break the glass spheres on the ground and begin to teleport.

talking-to-oldak-talking-to-goblins-arou.speaker: Zanik
talking-to-oldak-talking-to-goblins-arou.text: Yes! We're another tribe of goblins who live underground. We've been cut off from the surface for generations but now we're back.

talking-to-oldak-talking-to-goblins-arou.speaker: Goblin
talking-to-oldak-talking-to-goblins-arou.text: That General [Wartface/Bentnoze]. He live in big hut.

talking-to-oldak-talking-to-goblins-arou.speaker: Goblin
talking-to-oldak-talking-to-goblins-arou.text: He say [Bentnoze/Wartface] is leader but real leader is [Wartface/Bentnoze]!

talking-to-oldak-talking-to-goblins-arou.player: These goblins fight all the time, Zanik. Come on, Wartface and Bentnoze are both in the big hut.

the-goblin-generals.text: A cutscene of the generals meeting with Zanik and the player with Grubfoot in the background

the-goblin-generals.speaker: General Wartface
the-goblin-generals.text: Who you?

the-goblin-generals.speaker: Zanik
the-goblin-generals.text: I'm Zanik of the Dorgeshuun!

the-goblin-generals.speaker: General Wartface
the-goblin-generals.text: Lost tribe?

the-goblin-generals.speaker: Zanik
the-goblin-generals.text: That's right! We've been cut off from the outside world for thousands of years but now we're back!

the-goblin-generals.speaker: General Bentnoze
the-goblin-generals.text: So legend true!

the-goblin-generals.speaker: General Wartface
the-goblin-generals.text: What you want?

the-goblin-generals.player: Can you tell us anything about this mace?

the-goblin-generals.speaker: General Bentnoze
the-goblin-generals.text: That holy mace of Big High War God.

the-goblin-generals.speaker: General Wartface
the-goblin-generals.text: In time of great war, strongest goblin warriors carry maces like this.

the-goblin-generals.speaker: General Bentnoze
the-goblin-generals.text: They use them to take favour of gods away from enemy. If another god protecting enemy, goblin warrior use this mace and favour of god is stolen away!

the-goblin-generals.speaker: Zanik
the-goblin-generals.text: Oh. A holy mace of the War God.

the-goblin-generals.speaker: General Wartface
the-goblin-generals.text: You not look very happy.

the-goblin-generals.speaker: General Bentnoze
the-goblin-generals.text: You should praise Big High War God for giving you holy mace!

the-goblin-generals.player: The Dorgeshuun don't have quite the same attitude to the gods as you on the surface do.

the-goblin-generals.speaker: General Wartface
the-goblin-generals.text: All goblins worship Big High War God! Without him we nothing!

the-goblin-generals.speaker: General Bentnoze
the-goblin-generals.text: You not real goblin! You filthy human!

the-goblin-generals.speaker: Zanik
the-goblin-generals.text: I am a goblin!

the-goblin-generals.speaker: General Bentnoze
the-goblin-generals.text: You not even look like goblin! You have big eyes and wrong colour skin!

the-goblin-generals.speaker: Grubfoot
the-goblin-generals.text: She is goblin!

the-goblin-generals.speaker: General Bentnoze
the-goblin-generals.text: Shut up Grubfoot!

the-goblin-generals.speaker: General Wartface
the-goblin-generals.text: No let him speak.

the-goblin-generals.speaker: Grubfoot
the-goblin-generals.text: She is goblin. And she more than that...

the-goblin-generals.speaker: Grubfoot
the-goblin-generals.text: Last night I have dream. I see this new goblin come into village, holding up holy mace.

the-goblin-generals.speaker: Grubfoot
the-goblin-generals.text: All goblins gather around her. Not just from village, from all over world. She is Chosen Commander!

the-goblin-generals.speaker: General Wartface
the-goblin-generals.text: That story from goblin holy book. We not had Commander of all goblins since time of great war.

the-goblin-generals.speaker: General Wartface
the-goblin-generals.text: Holy book say someday Big High War God send Chosen Commander to lead us to victory over whole world.

the-goblin-generals.speaker: Grubfoot
the-goblin-generals.text: That what I see in dream. It her destiny.

the-goblin-generals.speaker: Zanik
the-goblin-generals.text: My destiny...

the-goblin-generals.speaker: General Bentnoze
the-goblin-generals.text: That not true! She cannot be Chosen Commander! She not proper goblin! She not worship Big High War God!

the-goblin-generals.speaker: General Wartface
the-goblin-generals.text: But what if she is? If we ignore her, Big High War God strike us down!

the-goblin-generals.speaker: General Bentnoze
the-goblin-generals.text: All right. I not believe you Chosen Commander. But we let you talk to people in village.

the-goblin-generals.speaker: General Wartface
the-goblin-generals.text: Grubfoot! Tell people in village to gather around! Dorgesh goblin will speak to us all!
Fade out to the generals addressing the goblins of Goblin Village

the-goblin-generals.speaker: General Wartface
the-goblin-generals.text: Goblins listen up! This Zanik, she from Dorgeshuun tribe!

the-goblin-generals.speaker: General Bentnoze
the-goblin-generals.text: She say she Chosen Commander!

the-goblin-generals.speaker: Zanik
the-goblin-generals.text: No, I-

the-goblin-generals.speaker: General Wartface
the-goblin-generals.text: We not know what she have to say. But in case she Chosen Commander, we let her speak. Speak, Zanik!

the-goblin-generals.speaker: Zanik
the-goblin-generals.text: Help, [player name]! What should I say?

the-goblin-generals.speaker: Zanik
the-goblin-generals.text: Goblins... goblins of the Goblin Village. I'm Zanik of the Dorgeshuun. You may know the legend of the Dorgeshuun, but let me tell you our own version.

the-goblin-generals.speaker: Zanik
the-goblin-generals.text: Thousands of years ago, the Big High War God forced all goblins to fight in a terrible war.
The goblins all raise their weapons and cheer.

the-goblin-generals.speaker: Goblins
the-goblin-generals.text: Big High War God! Big High War God!

the-goblin-generals.speaker: Zanik
the-goblin-generals.text: No! Listen! The god commanded the Dorgeshuun to fight a battle they could not win!

the-goblin-generals.speaker: Goblin
the-goblin-generals.text: You weak! You hide instead of fight!

the-goblin-generals.speaker: Zanik
the-goblin-generals.text: You don't need to think in those terms! We've lived for centuries without war, and without gods, and-
A goblin gets hit with a magical fire attack, scorching them to death.

the-goblin-generals.speaker: Goblin
the-goblin-generals.text: Aaaargh!
Another goblin gets hit with a arrow and dies.

the-goblin-generals.speaker: Goblin
the-goblin-generals.text: Unk!

the-goblin-generals.speaker: General Bentnoze
the-goblin-generals.text: We under attack!

the-goblin-generals.speaker: General Wartface
the-goblin-generals.text: Scatter!
The goblins scatter into buildings.
All the goblins are gone. Zanik and the player are hidden behind different buildings.

the-goblin-generals.speaker: Zanik
the-goblin-generals.text: The shots came from the top of that tower, [player name]! Can you see anything?

the-goblin-generals.player: There are two snipers up there.

the-goblin-generals.speaker: Zanik
the-goblin-generals.text: I can't get anywhere without coming into their line of fire, but I think you could get around the side of the buildings to the ladder.
end of cutscene

the-goblin-generals-walking-into-the-cen.text: An arrow thuds into the ground and forces you to jump back.

upon-defeating-the-two-h-a-m-members.text: Sigmund attacks Zanik in the centre of Goblin Village

upon-defeating-the-two-h-a-m-members.speaker: Sigmund
upon-defeating-the-two-h-a-m-members.text: You can never defeat me! I've been training my Combat by killing goblins around Lumbridge!

upon-defeating-the-two-h-a-m-members.speaker: Zanik
upon-defeating-the-two-h-a-m-members.text: You... you murderer!

upon-defeating-the-two-h-a-m-members.speaker: Zanik
upon-defeating-the-two-h-a-m-members.text: Quick, [player name]! Shoot him while I have him distracted!
Sigmund throws a flashbang on the ground and bright white light flashes.

upon-defeating-the-two-h-a-m-members.speaker: Zanik
upon-defeating-the-two-h-a-m-members.text: Aaaaah! My eyes!
Sigmund now has Zanik in front of him facing the player with his sword at her throat.

upon-defeating-the-two-h-a-m-members.speaker: Sigmund
upon-defeating-the-two-h-a-m-members.text: Don't even think about it, [player name]! Make one move and I'll slit her throat!

upon-defeating-the-two-h-a-m-members.speaker: Sigmund
upon-defeating-the-two-h-a-m-members.text: Your little goblin friend has a role in my plan! I'm taking her to the tunnel we've built from the Lumbridge Swamp Caves to the new dwarven train track.

upon-defeating-the-two-h-a-m-members.speaker: Sigmund
upon-defeating-the-two-h-a-m-members.text: When the cave goblins find that the dwarven train has killed their hero, there will be war between them! Saradomin's chosen children can watch as two vile underground races wipe each another out!

upon-defeating-the-two-h-a-m-members.speaker: Sigmund
upon-defeating-the-two-h-a-m-members.text: A-ha-ha-ha-ha-haaa!
Sigmund turns and backs out of the village with Zanik

upon-defeating-the-two-h-a-m-members.speaker: General Wartface
upon-defeating-the-two-h-a-m-members.text: Are they gone?

upon-defeating-the-two-h-a-m-members.speaker: General Bentnoze
upon-defeating-the-two-h-a-m-members.text: What happen?

upon-defeating-the-two-h-a-m-members.speaker: General Wartface
upon-defeating-the-two-h-a-m-members.text: He kidnap Chosen Commander? You must rescue her!

upon-defeating-the-two-h-a-m-members.speaker: General Bentnoze
upon-defeating-the-two-h-a-m-members.text: Human will need help. You take our best warrior, Sergeant Mossfists.

upon-defeating-the-two-h-a-m-members.speaker: General Wartface
upon-defeating-the-two-h-a-m-members.text: No! Sergeant Slimetoes best warrior! Take him!

upon-defeating-the-two-h-a-m-members.player: We don't have time for this! Why don't I take both warriors?

upon-defeating-the-two-h-a-m-members.speaker: General Bentnoze
upon-defeating-the-two-h-a-m-members.text: Okay.

upon-defeating-the-two-h-a-m-members.speaker: General Bentnoze
upon-defeating-the-two-h-a-m-members.text: Grubfoot! Fetch Mossfists and Slimetoes and tell them to meet [player name] in Lumbridge Swamp!

upon-defeating-the-two-h-a-m-members.speaker: General Bentnoze
upon-defeating-the-two-h-a-m-members.text: You take ancient goblin mace. Maybe it be useful.

upon-defeating-the-two-h-a-m-members.speaker: General Wartface
upon-defeating-the-two-h-a-m-members.text: You rescue Chosen Commander and she lead us all to glory!
end of cutscene

options.text: I've heard that one of your number has got hold of part of a map.

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: Pink robe man say they digging tunnel under Lumbridge Swamp Caves. You go there to rescue Chosen Commander.

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: Sergeants wait for you at entrance to Lumbridge Swamp Caves.

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: You take ancient goblin mace. Maybe it be useful.
If the player lost the ancient mace:

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: We know! Some goblin find it, give it back here.

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: Me tell you human not clever enough! He lose mace.

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: You want mace, you give us 1,000 coins. Maybe you not lose it again if you have to pay!
If the player doesn't have 1,000 coins:

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: You stupid human! You not have enough money!

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: When come back, bring 1,000 coins.
If the player has 1,000 coins:
1,000 coins
ancient mace

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: You take ancient goblin mace now and rescue Chosen Commander!

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: Remember, mace has power to rob enemy of power of Prayer!

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: Pink robe man say they digging tunnel under Lumbridge Swamp Caves. You go there to rescue Chosen Commander.

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: Sergeants wait for you at entrance to Lumbridge Swamp Caves.

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: Well then, human no get mace.

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: But me not think you able to kill Sigmund with no mace.

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: So if you care about big-eyed friend, you find 1,000 coins!

options.text: So how is life for the goblins?

upon-defeating-the-two-h-a-m-members-tal.speaker: Ambassador Alvijar
upon-defeating-the-two-h-a-m-members-tal.text: Thank you for helping with the dig! I hear that the work on the tunnel is now complete and the first train will be making the journey very soon!

upon-defeating-the-two-h-a-m-members-tal.player: You've got to stop the train! Sigmund is planning something terrible down there!

upon-defeating-the-two-h-a-m-members-tal.speaker: Ambassador Alvijar
upon-defeating-the-two-h-a-m-members-tal.text: What are you babbling about? Everyone was cleared out of the tunnel when we completed work. There's no reason to stop the train.

upon-defeating-the-two-h-a-m-members-att.text: The staircase is closed while the train station is being completed. You will have to find another way down there.

talking-to-the-sergeants-in-the-lumbridg.speaker: Sergeant Mossfists
talking-to-the-sergeants-in-the-lumbridg.text: Generals say we help you rescue Chosen Commander.

talking-to-the-sergeants-in-the-lumbridg.speaker: Sergeant Slimetoes
talking-to-the-sergeants-in-the-lumbridg.text: It too important for puny human to do on own. You just get killed.

talking-to-the-sergeants-in-the-lumbridg.speaker: Sergeant Mossfists
talking-to-the-sergeants-in-the-lumbridg.text: So we come to look after you so you not die.

talking-to-the-sergeants-in-the-lumbridg.speaker: Sergeant Slimetoes
talking-to-the-sergeants-in-the-lumbridg.text: Grubfoot say pink robe man take Chosen Commander down this hole into new tunnel.

talking-to-the-sergeants-in-the-lumbridg.speaker: Sergeant Mossfists/Slimetoes
talking-to-the-sergeants-in-the-lumbridg.text: Look, there new hole with ladder just next to climby-out rope. We go down there.

talking-to-the-sergeants-in-the-lumbridg.speaker: Sergeant Mossfists/Slimetoes
talking-to-the-sergeants-in-the-lumbridg.text: What we waiting for? We must go down into tunnel and rescue Chosen Commander!

the-under-underground.text: Shoulder view from the guard to the player and goblin sergeants
Fade out as the guard runs off

the-under-underground.speaker: Sergeant Mossfists
the-under-underground.text: Ha ha! Puny human scared of me!

the-under-underground.player: He's probably just gone to get reinforcements. He'll be back in a few moments with more guards.

steps.speaker: Sergeant Slimetoes
steps.text: Okay.

steps.speaker: Sergeant Slimetoes
steps.text: Okay.

steps.speaker: Sergeant Slimetoes
steps.text: Okay.

steps.speaker: Sergeant Slimetoes
steps.text: Okay.

steps.speaker: Sergeant Slimetoes
steps.text: Okay.

steps.speaker: Sergeant Mossfists/Slimetoes
steps.text: Quick! Me keep human busy!

steps.speaker: Sergeant Mossfists/Slimetoes
steps.text: Ha ha ha!

steps.speaker: Sergeant Mossfists/Slimetoes
steps.text: Take that!

the-distraction-if-the-guards-spot-the-p.text: You are caught and thrown out of the tunnel.

the-distraction-if-the-guard-at-the-end-.text: You are caught and thrown out of the tunnel.

the-distraction-talking-to-either-of-the.speaker: Sergeant Mossfists/Slimetoes
the-distraction-talking-to-either-of-the.text: You go quick! I keep guard busy!

climbing-down-to-the-railway.text: Sigmund has Zanik tied to the train tracks.

climbing-down-to-the-railway.speaker: Sigmund
climbing-down-to-the-railway.text: At last I have defeated you, you filthy goblin!

climbing-down-to-the-railway.speaker: Sigmund
climbing-down-to-the-railway.text: Any moment now the first dwarf train will come thundering down this tunnel and crush you! And then the goblins and the dwarves will go to war!

climbing-down-to-the-railway.speaker: Sigmund
climbing-down-to-the-railway.text: No, YOU'RE the monster! That's why you and all your filthy species must die!

climbing-down-to-the-railway.speaker: Sigmund
climbing-down-to-the-railway.text: This time your goblin friend cannot help you. You are on your own and have no way to overcome my prayers!
The cutscene ends and the fight starts

climbing-down-to-the-railway-attempting-.text: You cannot untie Zanik until you have defeated Sigmund!

attacking-him-with-the-ancient-mace-spec.speaker: Sigmund
attacking-him-with-the-ancient-mace-spec.text: What's happening? That weapon is overcoming Saradomin's protection! You've taken away the last of my prayer energy!

defeating-sigmund.speaker: Sigmund
defeating-sigmund.text: Bah! You win again, [player name]! But someday, somehow, I will have my revenge!

defeating-sigmund.speaker: Zanik
defeating-sigmund.text: Quick, [player name]! Untie me before the train comes!
The player unties Zanik from the railway and they both jump out of the way as the train goes by
~ The grand opening of the Dorgesh-Kaan - Keldagrim train line ~
Dwarves and goblins are cheering in the crowd faving Ur-tag, Zanik, and the player

defeating-sigmund.speaker: Ur-tag
defeating-sigmund.text: It gives me great pleasure to declare this new train link open!

defeating-sigmund.speaker: Ur-tag
defeating-sigmund.text: [player name], Zanik has told me about your exploits. It seems that all the Dorgeshuun owe you our lives once again.

defeating-sigmund.player: All in a day's work for an adventurer like me!

defeating-sigmund.speaker: Ur-tag
defeating-sigmund.text: As a reward, I suggest you keep the ancient goblin mace that you helped to excavate.

defeating-sigmund.speaker: Ur-tag
defeating-sigmund.text: Most of the Dorgeshuun would be happy if such a war-like artefact was kept outside the city, and I am sure you will keep it in safe hands.
